# Solwers Q2’26: Första halvåret var svagare än förväntat

**Feed**: inderes-se  
**Published**: 2026-08-25  
**Market Sentiment**: Negative

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a company interview with Solwers CEO Johan Ernroth about the Q2 2026 report. The first half of the year was weaker than expected. Revenue fell faster in Q2 because the Swedish industrial business struggled with tough competition and low billing rates. The company issued a profit warning in June and withdrew its outlook. It is now cutting staff, closing small offices and renegotiating covenants so that net debt/EBITDA must reach 3.5x by June 2027. The infrastructure business in Sweden and Finland is the bright spot, but management says it cannot yet see how well the turnaround measures are working.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ SOLWERS — Solwers | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

H1 missed its own targets, guidance withdrawn, covenant waiver and renegotiated financing, low billing rate, and wage inflation not passed on to prices.

#### Reasoning

The CEO admits the Q2 recovery did not happen. Swedish industrial units have too many idle staff and low billing rates in a tough competitive market. Hourly prices are flat despite wage inflation. The June covenant waiver and the new 3.5x ND/EBITDA target depend on better EBITDA, not on paying down debt. Management says it cannot yet see whether the measures are working. The Swedish/Finnish infra segment is stable, but this is a turnaround with balance-sheet risk. Stay away until margins recover

#### Sell Triggers

- if billing rate and EBITDA recover visibly in coming quarters
- if company reinstates guidance
- if ND/EBITDA covenant path to 3.5x is clearly on track

> *"Vi hade för många på bänken. Vi hade låg faktureringsgrad och det var det som orsakade problemen där."*
